title: Clean up a phone number
hints: Look at the text one character at a time and decide for each one whether to keep it.
`for ch in phone:` visits every character. `ch.isdigit()` tells you whether it's 0–9. Add the keepers to a result string with `+=`.
`result = ""`, then `for ch in phone: if ch.isdigit(): result += ch`, then `return result`
